title: Scarab Throne Entity
description: A surreal humanoid figure with a golden crown and beetle head sits atop a massive mound of black scarab beetles and golden rings. The figure holds an open book in one hand while insects swarm around its outstretched arms and floating halo-like symbols.
prompt: A surreal humanoid figure with a scarab beetle head and ornate golden crown dripping black ooze, wearing arm bands, seated on a giant mound made of black scarab beetles and scattered golden rings. The figure holds an open book in its left hand while more beetles and insects fly around it, with abstract circular symbols and dripping elements floating above its head, rendered in detailed dark fantasy style with smoky background and floating particles
